name: bums.showdown.w2-b.name
authorNotes: Showdown / survive, 2-4 players, enclosed single-screen arena (no split-screen camera needed, §5). All four spawn together on the base island; ketchup-rise is a crusher shaped as a rising wall, its path climbing from y1300 (below the island) to y150 (above the top perch) at 15.3px/s — a ~75s rise from base to summit, matching §8.2's 'closing lethal boundary forces an end within 75s'. Same schema-gap approximation as World 1's tide arena (Hazard has no time-varying shape/size, only a static Shape plus a kinematic path), flagged here for the same reason. Unlike the World 1 arena, the mid ledge itself is greased (material grease) rather than plain paper — the perch you retreat to under pressure is already slick, so staying up there under a rising deadline is harder than the climb itself. Players retreat upward via swing-survive-mid then swing-survive-top as the rise climbs; the top perch holds only one comfortably. relic-w2-b sits on the top perch as a risk/reward pickup for the haul objective. A static void strip under the base island punishes anyone knocked clean off before the rise even arrives.
